The '''Powermax fusion lantern''' was a [[Fusion lantern/Legends|Fusion lantern]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It cost 150 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
